statusDefinitions.implemented: Present in repository and usable for the described scope; tests or runtime evidence should still be checked.
statusDefinitions.partial: Implemented in a limited scope with documented constraints.
statusDefinitions.unverified: Configured or present, but the current runtime/deployment behavior has not been confirmed.

features.name: Versioned graph archive
features.notes: Synthetic demonstration graph; not verified real-world facts.

features.name: Graph, source, claim, evidence, and artifact corpus loader
features.notes: Validation establishes structure and references, not factual truth.

features.name: Bounded typed traversal and query API
features.notes: Deterministic traversal, not semantic search or truth ranking.

features.name: JSON/JSONL submission validation preview
features.notes: Dry-run only; no persistence or authorization.

features.name: Curated outbound endpoint profiles and bounded client
features.notes: Profiles are configured; live connectivity and production egress controls are not verified.

features.name: Static GitHub Pages landing and documentation site
features.notes: Workflow is configured; public deployment must be verified after merge to main and Pages settings.

features.name: Browser portal for graph search, relationships, source/evidence, submission preview, and endpoint registry
features.notes: Read-only static client; search is lexical and graph relationships use the canonical graph only.

features.name: Embedding-backed semantic search
features.notes: No embedding model or vector index is wired into this repository.

features.name: Authorized persistent submission service
features.notes: Requires server-side authentication, authorization, conflict handling, audit log, and durable storage.

features.name: Scheduled live endpoint health checks
features.notes: Configured endpoint profiles do not imply current reachability.
